## 💰 Cost Analysis
Cost tracking per department (APIM product subscription) compared against monthly quotas. Prices from PRICING_CL custom table (per 1M tokens).

content.query:
let dedicatedLlm = ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog
| where TimeGenerated >= startofmonth(now()) and TimeGenerated <= endofmonth(now())
| where isnotempty(DeploymentName)
| project TimeGenerated, CorrelationId, DeploymentName, PromptTokens=toreal(PromptTokens), CompletionTokens=toreal(CompletionTokens);
let legacyLlm = AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated >= startofmonth(now()) and TimeGenerated <= endofmonth(now())
| where Category == 'GatewayLlmLogs'
| where isnotempty(deploymentName_s) and totalTokens_d > 0
| project TimeGenerated, CorrelationId, DeploymentName=deploymentName_s, PromptTokens=toreal(promptTokens_d), CompletionTokens=toreal(completionTokens_d);
let llmLogs = union isfuzzy=true dedicatedLlm, legacyLlm;
let dedicatedGateway = ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where TimeGenerated >= startofmonth(now())
| summarize SubscriptionName=take_any(ApimSubscriptionId) by CorrelationId;
let legacyGateway = AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated >= startofmonth(now())
| where Category == 'GatewayLogs'
| summarize SubscriptionName=take_any(apimSubscriptionId_s) by CorrelationId;
let gatewayLogs = union isfuzzy=true dedicatedGateway, legacyGateway | summarize SubscriptionName=take_any(SubscriptionName) by CorrelationId;
llmLogs
| join kind=leftouter gatewayLogs on CorrelationId
| project SubscriptionName, DeploymentName, PromptTokens, CompletionTokens
| join kind=inner (
    PRICING_CL
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Model
    | project Model, InputTokensPrice, OutputTokensPrice
) on $left.DeploymentName == $right.Model
| extend InputCost = PromptTokens * InputTokensPrice / 1000000.0
| extend OutputCost = CompletionTokens * OutputTokensPrice / 1000000.0
| summarize TotalCost = round(sum(InputCost + OutputCost), 6) by SubscriptionName
| join kind=inner (
    SUBSCRIPTION_QUOTA_CL
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Subscription
    | project Subscription, CostQuota
) on $left.SubscriptionName == $right.Subscription
| project Department = replace_string(SubscriptionName, 'subscription-', ''), CostQuota, TotalCost
content.title: Cost by Department vs Quota (Current Month)

let legacyLlm = AzureDiagnostics
| where Category == 'GatewayLlmLogs'
| where isnotempty(deploymentName_s) and totalTokens_d > 0
| project TimeGenerated, CorrelationId, DeploymentName=deploymentName_s, PromptTokens=toreal(promptTokens_d), CompletionTokens=toreal(completionTokens_d);

let legacyGateway = AzureDiagnostics
| where Category == 'GatewayLogs'
| summarize SubscriptionName=take_any(apimSubscriptionId_s) by CorrelationId;
let gatewayLogs = union isfuzzy=true dedicatedGateway, legacyGateway | summarize SubscriptionName=take_any(SubscriptionName) by CorrelationId;
llmLogs
| join kind=leftouter gatewayLogs on CorrelationId
| project TimeGenerated, SubscriptionName, DeploymentName, PromptTokens, CompletionTokens

    PRICING_CL
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Model
    | project Model, InputTokensPrice, OutputTokensPrice

content.json:
## 📊 Usage Analysis
Token consumption and request volume broken down by model and department.

content.query:
let dedicatedLlm = ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog
| where isnotempty(DeploymentName)
| project DeploymentName, TotalTokens=toreal(TotalTokens);
let legacyLlm = AzureDiagnostics
| where Category == 'GatewayLlmLogs'
| where isnotempty(deploymentName_s) and totalTokens_d > 0
| project DeploymentName=deploymentName_s, TotalTokens=toreal(totalTokens_d);
union isfuzzy=true dedicatedLlm, legacyLlm
| summarize Requests = count(), TotalTokens = sum(TotalTokens) by Model = DeploymentName
| order by Requests desc
content.title: Requests & Tokens by Model
Token Usage by Department
